Compositions

Scores & strategies

Combat score: wins plus half draws, weighted 25% Version 34 workbook boards, 25% historical official API boards (rules 33), and 50% cross-tag score. Cross-tag score tests other trait families, with each opposing family weighted equally. Same-family matchups are available in Matchups. Level 8 faces level 8; level 9 faces level 9, with six items and no Seals. Scores require the exact upgrades shown and do not measure ranked win rates or the chance of reaching the board.

S: combat score at least 65%, cross-tag at least 55%, and at least 50% against each reference group. A: combat score at least 50%. B: below 50%. Every composition keeps its measured tier.

Board Value: the gold needed to buy every copy on the board (2★ = 3 copies, 3★ = 9 copies).

Strategy labels describe when to roll or level: Reroll 5, Reroll 6, Reroll 7, Fast 8, or Legendary.

Practical progression: suggested level 5 to 8 boards, with level 9 extensions where shown, with temporary item holders and fewer simultaneous upgrades. These revised boards have no combat score. Cheap reroll carries remain 3★ in the later progression after their upgrade; level 7 carries can stabilize at 2★. The 8 cap and 9 cap tabs preserve the exact tested boards. S/A/B tiers and headline percentages describe those caps.

Capped combat method: the Version 34 game engine, twelve fixed seeds and both board sides for every pair, at most six finished items per board. Carry and tank items were re-tested with the Version 34 best-in-slot results. Flexible slots on the strongest boards were tested against passive trait units (Ghost, Dragon) and utility units (Chansey and others) as well as higher-cost options. No shops, item drops, weather or Seals are simulated.

Progression study: 6,848 complete native v34 eight-seat matches across all 48 compositions, including 64 practical matches and 32 with Seals per composition. All 28 reroll compositions also received 64 cap-chase matches. The native elite planner controls economy and acquired items; it is not optimal human play. Another 133,688 fights compared attained boards. These results inform guidance and do not replace capped combat tiers or represent ranked win rates.

Upgrade odds: exact carry-line tests, 512 fixed seeds per condition, at the displayed level and budget. Hover or focus for owned copies, enemy-held copies and a 95% interval. Gold pays for rerolls and purchases; starting copies are already owned. No income, leveling, Seals or other purchases. These are conditional shop chances, not chances of surviving to complete a board.

Sources: official meta API (player data, rules 33 until the API publishes Version 34); community workbook (Version 34 boards). Opponent sources do not set tiers.
